records.issue_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:8 — The credential-sync response is returned without checking its HTTP status or validating its content, allowing 4xx/5xx responses to enter token-processing code as successful refreshes.
records.rationale: In refreshOAuthTokens.ts, the credential-sync branch does `const response = await fetch(...); return response;` with no `response.ok`/status check. Callers (zoom, office365, webex) then feed this Response into token-processing code expecting an OAuth-shaped body; a 4xx/5xx from CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT (or a non-JSON error page) will be parsed as if it were a successful token refresh, potentially corrupting stored credentials. The non-sync path's `refreshFunction` returns provider responses whose shapes downstream handlers know; the sync path introduces an unvalidated arbitrary-endpoint
